milestone: Motion Studio #104 bounded named editable project library
implementation: Eight local editable projects, independent IDs and saves, read-only legacy preservation, accepted opaque receipts, transaction-local CAS, protected recovery and exact portable Project2 backups.

native.method: Documented staged actual Chromium runs. First failures and scope-specific repairs are retained in separate receipts; this is not a single final local all-121 run.

sourceReview: Independent read-only review of the final data ownership, raw recovery and storage guards found no remaining material issue.
maximumAcceptance: In progress separately against eight original exact-cap frozen fixtures; no completed maximum claim yet.
limits: Local browser storage only, no account/hosted sharing.
Only selected-project images decode; serialized caps do not guarantee available quota or peak memory.
Raw recovery data never grants overwrite authority; unsafe/uncomparable or malformed catalog data stays protected.
Controlled pagehide/pageshow events exercise lifecycle handlers, not physical BFCache acceptance.
Clock-injected synchronous expiry branch is separate from the real 10-second native transaction timeout.
